From Vaswani et al. (2017) — Attention is All You Need:
  - Model dimensions: d_model=512, d_ff=2048, h=8 attention heads.
  - Scaled dot-product attention formula:
    Attention(Q,K,V) = softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k)) * V
  - The sqrt(d_k) scaling factor is critical: without it, large d_k values cause dot products to grow in magnitude, pushing softmax into saturation regions where gradients vanish.
  - Positional encoding uses sinusoidal functions:
    PE(pos, 2i) = sin(pos / 10000^(2i/d_model))
  - Course note: multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions.
